subject: Next steps: Junction POC timetable, owners, and acceptance gates
body:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lin <sam.l@junction.ai>
Cc: Elliot Grant <elliot@junction.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 15:20:00 -0000
Subject: Next steps: Junction POC timetable, owners, and acceptance gates

Hi Samantha — great call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the POC window.

Recap (30-min discovery):
- Goal: Prove Redwood reduces end-to-end inference latency for Junction’s customer-facing search by >=40% while maintaining model parity on top-1 intent.
- Scope: 2 endpoints (search query completion and reranking for top-10), sample dataset of ~50k production queries, and one week of spike testing.

Proposed success criteria (we discussed these on the call):
1) Latency: p95 token latency under 180ms for the reranker under realistic concurrency (as measured by our loadrunner harness).
2) Quality: No more than 2% drop in top-1 intent compared to your current baseline on the evaluation prompt set.
3) Stability: No unhandled errors during a 1-hour sustained load test at 2x expected production concurrency.

POC window suggestion: 3 weeks total
- Week 0 (kickoff & infra setup): account onboarding, model pinning, sample data ingestion, access checks.
- Week 1 (integration & smoke): route sampling, basic validation, opt batching + cache config.
- Week 2 (stress & readout): spike test, regen of metrics, final readout.

Owners (please confirm):
- Redwood: Diego Fernandez (overall), Marissa Cole (instrumentation & metrics), Monica Patel (security/compliance liaison).
- Junction: Samantha Lin (product), Elliot Grant (platform), plus Legal for final NDA items.

Open items for kickoff:
- Confirm data access method (S3 vs direct export) and sample files (we need ~50k rows).
- SOC2 evidence request — can we get a pointer to your compliance contacts?
- Calendar: propose kickoff Tue, Jul 6 10:00 AM PT (alternate Wed 7th).

If that matches, I’ll send a formal runbook & calendar invites with owners and weekly check-ins.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
---
From: Samantha Lin <sam.l@junction.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elliot Grant <elliot@junction.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Next steps: Junction POC timetable, owners, and acceptance gates

Thanks Diego — that aligns with our internal read of the call. Quick answers:
- We agree the success criteria look reasonable. I’ll validate the top-1 tolerance with Product and confirm any adjustments by Monday.
- Data: we can expose a sanitized S3 bucket; I’ll request a short-lived IAM role. Expect sample data by end of day Monday (we’ll put a README with schema).
- Compliance: legal wants a SOC2 summary and any data retention guarantees from Redwood. Can Marissa/Monica point me to the artifacts you can share?

Kickoff: Tue, Jul 6 10:00 AM PT works for our core team. I’ll add Elliot and our infra lead to the invite after confirming with Legal.

—Sam
Samantha Lin
Head of Product | Junction AI
---
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lin <sam.l@junction.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Next steps: Junction POC timetable, owners, and acceptance gates

Appended the POC runbook and a short checklist (attachments). Main highlights below — please skim and flag anything we should change before kickoff.

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood_poc_runbook_v1.pdf (runbook: timeline, artifact list, test harnesses, measurement queries)
- data-access-checklist.xlsx (fields, redaction guidance, S3 policy template)
- signed-nda-junction.pdf (previous NDA we can update if legal wants changes)

Key operational notes from runbook:
- Access: we prefer temporary IAM role + least-privilege S3 read. If you need a different flow (VPN, sftp), we can adapt during Week 0.
- Instrumentation: Marissa will provide a lightweight SDK snippet to emit latency and top-k metrics back to our readout bundle. That’s non-blocking (5–10 lines).
- Weekly cadence: 30-min internal sync every Wednesday (Redwood + Junction eng + product), and a 60-min final readout at end of Week 2.
- Decision gates: sign-off after Week 1 smoke to proceed to stress testing (explicit accept/decline by both teams).

Please confirm: 1) kickstart date, 2) who in Legal owns SOC2 exchange, 3) any calendar restrictions for weekly syncs. Once confirmed I’ll put calendar holds.

Diego

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Jul 2027 17:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Next steps: Junction POC timetable, owners, and acceptance gates

Looping in a few internal specifics I’ll own during the run:
- I’ll deliver the instrumentation snippet and a sample dashboard by EOD Monday (template for p95/p50/p99 and top-1/precision slices).
- I’ll also include a small eval set (1k queries) we can use for the quality check to avoid touching production.

Monica — can you assemble the SOC2 summary and retention policy we can share with Junction Legal? If you can also include the minimal list of logs we’ll provide during the POC (audit events, token-level latency, request hashes), that’ll speed legal review.

Diego — I’ll be the point for readout artifacts and will prep the metrics deck for the final meeting.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Ops | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Next steps: Junction POC timetable, owners, and acceptance gates

All good from our side — confirming kickoff Tue Jul 6 10:00 AM PT (I joined the invite and added Elliot).

We uploaded a sanitized sample S3 dataset to the link in your checklist and shared a short README; the IAM role request is in flight — I’ll forward the role ARN when it’s ready. Legal asked for the SOC2 summary and retention language you mentioned; thanks for turning that around quickly.

Next steps from Junction:
- I’ll send a brief internal note to engineering and tag the infra lead for the IAM role (ETA today).
- Confirming we’ll attend the weekly Wednesday syncs — remove any blockers and surface gating decisions the Monday before the week transition.

See you Tuesday.

—Sam
Samantha Lin
Head of Product | Junction AI
